belongs_to_collection.name: The Lion of the Highlands Collection

data.overview: When English soldiers kill his beloved bride, Scottish warrior Alistair Wallace answers with rebellion. His personal fury gathers the villages into a rising struggle for freedom from the crown's rule.
data.tagline: Some lives are measured by the freedom they win.
data.title: The Lion of the Highlands
